name: CybaaBot
description: The broad-crawl half of Cybaa's two documented agents. Cybaa's bot policy says it "performs broad security research by crawling the top 1 million domains obtained from Crawler.Ninja operated by Scott Helme", to identify "misconfigurations, adoption of security headers, and general domain-level security posture" and "to provide aggregate insights to the security community". The operator describes it as "designed to be benign and non-disruptive" and, at the time the page was read, said it was "in the submission process with Cloudflare to be listed as a Verified Bot".
